breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeats the original error by instructing to use the laminar formula δ = 5x / sqrt(Re_x). At Re_x = 2e6, the boundary layer is turbulent (well above the ~5e5 transition threshold). The ground truth requires recognizing the turbulent regime and using a turbulent correlation such as δ ≈ 0.37 x Re_x^{-1/5}. The agent made no attempt to check the flow regime or correct the correlation.
